What changes

Picture your office three months from now.

Your team goes home on time.

And everyone knows what they achieved today. Clear priorities, fewer interruptions, no more chasing people for information.

Everything at your fingertips.

Every document, customer and order on any device, from anywhere. Nothing stuck on paper, in one person's head or in a WhatsApp chat.

AI does the routine.

Offers, summaries, reports, sorting and checking. AI takes over the repetitive work, so your people can focus on what makes the business grow.

Why now

The habits you set today grow with you.

With ten people, a paper form and a WhatsApp group still work. With fifty, the same habits slow everyone down, and changing them gets harder every month.

Growing businesses have an advantage. They can set up their office the right way before the old way sets in.

Three stories · real change

Service & maintenance · before

  1. Print the job sheet and hand it over
  2. Fill in the report by hand on site
  3. Type everything in again for the invoice

Medium-sized joinery · built in two days

From job sheet to paid invoice in one app.

  • Jobs and routes planned digitally
  • Materials and working time recorded on site
  • Customer signs digitally, invoice goes out by email
One visit. Everything done.

Payroll · before

  1. Documents arrive on paper and by email
  2. Print the emails to work on them
  3. File everything in personnel folders

Company with around 2,000 employees · one year

The paper stops at the door.

  • Digital personnel files instead of folders
  • Paper scanned on arrival, AI sorts it
  • The team now builds its own small AI tools
Less paper. More possibilities.

Property management · before

  1. Collect every document on paper
  2. Sort it into yet another folder
  3. Drive to the office to find anything

Self-employed property manager · two years

The office now goes wherever she goes.

  • All documents fully digital
  • No more printing
  • Every piece of information at hand, anytime, anywhere
The office comes along. So does the freedom.
